reopen-after-kill.says: A pod whose app was stopped without closing it (a crash, a killed process or a power cut after the import) is opened again and answers its first question: the pod has no saved database, so it is built again from every file it holds and the first question is answered from that build; the database is built after that answer, without the question waiting for it, so the questions after it are answered from it once it is built.
reopen-after-kill.total: Opening a pod that was stopped before it closed and answering its first read, which does not wait for the database to be built: what a person waits for after the app was stopped without closing the pod.
